corpus: Lexguard Seed Corpus — Indian High Court Judgments & Orders

source.note: 6 files were saved from https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis under the generic browser title 'Home | Judgements and Orders, Supreme Court and High courts of India.pdf'; the remaining 23 carry content-hash style names.

documents.title: Karuppasamy v. State of Tamil Nadu (Bail Appeal — SC/ST PoA Act)
documents.parties: Karuppasamy v. State of Tamil Nadu, Inspector of Police Melur PS & Muthuraja
documents.summary: Appeal under Section 14-A(2) of the SC/ST (Amendment) Act, 2015 against the order dated 01.09.2026 of the III Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR), Madurai, refusing bail in Crime No. 560/2025 (BNS Sections 191(2), 191(3), 296(b), 118(2), 109(1), 351(3) and SC/ST Act Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(2)(v)). Appellant surrendered on 01.09.2026; all co-accused are on bail; investigation complete; bail was refused below only because a non-bailable warrant was pending since 10.04.2026.

documents.title: Chandirasekaran Veeranan v. Superintendent of Police, Theni (Festival Police Protection)
documents.parties: Chandirasekaran Veeranan v. Superintendent of Police, Theni District & Inspector of Police, Gudaloor North PS
documents.summary: Writ under Article 226 seeking to quash the rejection in Na.Ka.No.10 dated 25.09.2026 and to direct adequate police protection for the Sri Mandhaiamman Koil Thiruvizhia (Adalum Padalum function) on 14.10.2026 at Keelagudalur, Theni; DGP circulars placed on record.

documents.title: E. Sivagamasundari v. S. Elanselvi (Contempt — Cooperative Bank Order)
documents.parties: E. Sivagamasundari v. S. Elanselvi, Joint Registrar, Cuddalore District Central Cooperative Bank Ltd.
documents.summary: Contempt petition under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 to punish disobedience of the order in WP No. 15163 of 2020 dated 14.02.2024. The Division Bench order dated 01.10.2026 in the connected writ appeal kept the contempt proceedings in abeyance; petition closed with liberty to revive after disposal of the writ appeal.

documents.title: Annapurna Swadisht Ltd v. GEF Foods India Pvt Ltd (Trademark Injunction)

No. 223 of 2026, plus the underlying suits for ad-interim injunction restraining infringement of the registered trademark ANNAPOORNA by the identical mark ANNAPURNA and for passing off.

documents.title: Silu Chhinchani v. State (NDPS Bail — Tambaram Ganja Case)
documents.parties: Silu Chhinchani v. State rep. by Inspector of Police, PEW Tambaram (Cr. No. 52 of 2025)
act_tags: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
documents.summary: Bail petition under Section 483 BNSS by the sole accused in Crime No. 52 of 2025 (PEW Tambaram, registered 08.04.2025) for interception with ganja near Anakaputhur; final report taken on file as CC No. 758 of 2025 before the Special Court for EC and NDPS Act, Chennai. This is the petitioner's sixth bail petition.

documents.title: M. Vishnu v. Supriya Sahu IAS (Contempt — Forest Department Compliance)
documents.parties: M. Vishnu (Forest Plot Watcher) v. Supriya Sahu IAS, Secretary, Environment & Forests Dept. & Ors.
documents.summary: Contempt petition alleging wilful disobedience of the order dated 10.11.2025 in W.P. No. 2939 of 2019. The Government issued G.O. 2(D) No. 153 dated 07.10.2026 granting seniority-list inclusion and appointment as Forest Watcher; respondents substantially complied, so the petition was closed with no order as to costs.

documents.title: Prasanth v. Superintendent of Police, Madurai (Police Protection — Kabaddi Tournament)

documents.title: Amul v. Asian Beverage Pvt Ltd (Summary Judgment — TRUE VALLEY / AMUL TRU)
documents.parties: Kaira District Co-operative Milk Producers Union Ltd (Amul Dairy) v. Asian Beverage Private Limited, Chennai
documents.summary: Application by the applicant/defendant (Amul) for a summary judgment under Order XIII-A CPC dismissing C.S.(Comm.Div.) No. 161 of 2022, in which the plaintiff (Asian Beverage Pvt Ltd) alleges infringement of its registered trademark TRUE VALLEY (Reg. No. 2276842, Class 32, used since 26.01.2012) by Amul's use of AMUL TRU. Pronounced 09.10.2026 after reservation on 01.10.2026.

documents.title: Ram Kumar M v. Gogireddy Lalitha Reddy (Parenting Plan Appeal)

documents.summary: Common judgment in Letters Patent appeals against the Single Judge's order dated 01.10.2026 on Point No. 3 of Part 2 of the Joint Parenting Plan governing the child's stay with the respondent-mother during Dussehra holidays (09.10.2026–25.10.2026), where school days overlapped; the court interacted with the mother and counsel and adjusted the schedule.

documents.title: Rajwanti & Another v. State of Haryana (Notional Promotion & Arrears)
documents.court: High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh
documents.parties: Rajwanti & another v. State of Haryana & others (Dept. of Agriculture, Haryana)
documents.summary: Civil Writ Petition under Article 226 to quash orders dated 09.01.2020 and 31.05.2023 granting only notional retrospective promotions to Late Sh. documents.title: Meena Dewangan v. State of Chhattisgarh (Supervisor Recruitment — PH Quota)
